items.exampleEn: The sharp nail penetrated the wooden board easily.
items.exampleZh: 那根尖釘子輕易地穿透了木板。

items.exampleEn: The coach invoked an old team rule: no phones at dinner.
items.exampleZh: 教練援引一條老隊規：晚餐時不准用手機。

items.exampleEn: Board games are enjoying a revival among young people.
items.exampleZh: 桌遊在年輕人之間重新流行起來。

items.exampleEn: The company fulfilled every order before the holidays.
items.exampleZh: 那家公司在假期前完成了每一筆訂單。

items.exampleEn: She is the current holder of the world record.
items.exampleZh: 她是目前的世界紀錄保持人。
items.glossZh: 保持者；持有人；（放東西的）架

items.exampleEn: We heard a strange rattle coming from the car engine.
items.exampleZh: 我們聽到車子引擎傳來奇怪的格格聲。

items.exampleEn: The vase shattered when the cat knocked it off the shelf.
items.exampleZh: 貓把花瓶從架子上撞下來，花瓶摔得粉碎。

items.exampleEn: I didn't mean to startle you; I thought you heard me come in.
items.exampleZh: 我不是故意嚇你的，我以為你聽到我進來了。

items.sentenceEn: Only ticket holders may enter the hall after seven.
items.sentenceZh: 七點以後只有持票者可以進入大廳。

items.audioEn: A loud noise startled the cat, and it jumped onto the top of the fridge.
items.audioZh: 一聲巨響把貓嚇了一跳，牠跳到冰箱頂上。

items.sentenceEn: The judge invoked a rarely used law in her decision.
items.sentenceZh: 法官在判決中援引了一條很少用到的法律。

items.sentenceEn: The cold wind penetrated the thin walls of the old house.
items.sentenceZh: 寒風穿透了老房子薄薄的牆。

items.stemEn: After ten years of hard work, he finally ____ his dream of opening a bakery.
items.stemZh: 經過十年的努力，他終於實現了開麵包店的夢想。

items.stemEn: The baby laughed every time she shook her little ____.
items.stemZh: 寶寶每次搖她的小搖鈴都會笑。

items.passageEn: Last month, an old theater in our city opened again after twenty years. The owners hope it will lead to a revival of live shows in the area. The actors had spent weeks in rehearsal, and on the first night, the audience was startled when the lights suddenly went out, but it was part of the play. Later, the sound of a glass shattering on stage made everyone jump again. The director said she had fulfilled a promise to her father, who once worked there. Ticket holders for the next show get a free drink.
items.passageZh: 上個月，我們市裡一間老劇院在關閉二十年後重新開幕。老闆們希望這能帶動這一帶現場表演的復興。演員們排練了好幾週，首演那晚燈光突然熄滅，觀眾嚇了一跳，不過那是劇情的一部分。後來，舞台上玻璃碎裂的聲音又讓大家嚇得跳起來。導演說，她實現了對父親的承諾，她父親以前曾在那裡工作。下一場表演的持票人可以免費得到一杯飲料。

questions.questionZh: 首演時燈光突然熄滅是怎麼回事？
下一場表演的持票人有什麼好處？

items.promptZh: 陽光穿不透茂密的森林。
referenceEn: Sunlight could not penetrate the thick forest.
The sunlight can't penetrate the thick forest.
rubricZh: 要用 penetrate（例如 could not penetrate）
「茂密的」可寫，例如 thick、dense 等
時態合理即可（例如 could not、can't）

items.promptZh: 那個壞消息徹底擊垮了她的信心。
referenceEn: The bad news completely shattered her confidence.
Her confidence was completely shattered by the bad news.
rubricZh: shatter 在這裡是比喻用法，表示「使破滅、擊垮」；主動或被動都可以
「徹底」可寫，例如 completely、totally 等，位置不扣分
時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 shattered、has shattered 等）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 第②關 issue 結案：「the coach invoked memories of last year's win」：喚起回憶的標準用字是 evoke，invoke memories 常被視為誤用；invoke 的主流義是援引（法規、權威）或祈求。建議釋義第一義改「援引（法規）」並換例句（跟讀句 The judge invoked a rarely used law 的用法正確）。
